customization.text: Setting your appearanceBefore you get started, you'll need to set the appearance of your character. Please use the open interface to set your appearance.
Past ExperienceBefore you get started, please use the open interface to select your experience with Old School RuneScape.

options.text: I'm brand new! This is my first time here.
I've played in the past, but not recently.

customization.text: Getting startedWhen you're ready to get started, click on the Gielinor Guide. He is indicated by a flashing yellow arrow.

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them you can talk to them.

gielinor-guide.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide.text: Now then, let's start by looking at your settings menu.
Settings menuPlease [click/tap] on the flashing spanner icon found on the bottom right of your screen. This will display your settings menu.

gielinor-guide-attempting-to-leave-the-b.text: You need to talk to the Gielinor Guide before you are allowed to proceed through this door.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Settings menuOn the side panel, you can now see a variety of game settings. You can also [click/tap] the all settings button to see all available settings. Talk to the Gielinor Guide to continue.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.

gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-after-opening-settings-me.text: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!

Moving onIt's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is [click/tap] on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them, you can talk to them.

gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.speaker: Gielinor Guide
gielinor-guide-talking-to-the-gielinor-g.text: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!

Moving onIt's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is [click/tap] on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-attempting-to-chop-down-.text: You cannot cut down this tree yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.

survival-expert-attempting-to-fish-for-s.text: You cannot fish here yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.

survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.text: Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.

survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-talking-to-the-survival-.text: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
The survival expert gives you a small fishing net.
You've been given an itemTo view the item you've been given, you'll need to open your inventory. To do so, [click/tap] on the flashing backpack icon to the right hand side of your screen.

survival-expert-attempting-to-leave-thro.text: You need to talk to the Survival Guide and complete her tasks before you are allowed to proceed through this gate.

survival-expert-after-opening-inventory.text: InventoryThis is your inventory. You can view all of your items here, including the net you've just been given. Let's use it to catch some shrimp.

survival-expert-before-fishing.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-fishing.text: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.

survival-expert-after-clicking-on-a-fish.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to catch some shrimp. Sit back for a moment while [he does/she does/they do] all the hard work.
You manage to catch some shrimp.
You've gained some experience[Click/Tap] on the flashing bar graph icon near the inventory button to see your skills menu.

survival-expert-before-opening-skills-me.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-opening-skills-me.text: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.

survival-expert-after-fishing.player: I've managed to catch some shrimp.

survival-expert-after-fishing.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-after-fishing.text: Excellent work. Next you'll want to cook those shrimp. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
The survival expert gives you a bronze axe and a tinderbox.

WoodcuttingIt's time to cook your shrimp. However, you require a fire to do that which means you need some logs. You can cut down trees using your Woodcutting skill, all you need is an axe. Give it a go by clicking on one of the trees in the area.

survival-expert-before-cutting-a-tree.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-cutting-a-tree.text: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.

survival-expert-attempting-to-equip-an-i.text: You'll be told how to equip items later.

survival-expert-after-clicking-on-a-tree.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cut down the tree. Sit back for a moment while [he/she] does all the hard work.
You manage to cut some logs.

FiremakingNow that you have some logs, it's time to light a fire. First, [click/tap] on the tinderbox in your inventory. Then, with the tinderbox highlighted, [click/tap] on the logs to use the tinderbox on them.

survival-expert-before-lighting-a-fire.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-lighting-a-fire.text: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.

survival-expert-after-using-tinderbox-on.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to light a fire. This should only take a few seconds.

steps.text: CookingNow it's time to get cooking. To do so, [click/tap] on the shrimp in your inventory. Then, with the shrimp highlighted, [click/tap] on a fire to cook them. If you look at the top left of the screen, you'll see the instructions that you're giving to your character.
CookingNow it's time to get cooking. To do so, [click/tap] on the shrimp in your inventory. Then, with the shrimp highlighted, [click/tap] on a fire to cook them.

survival-expert-before-cooking-the-shrim.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-before-cooking-the-shrim.text: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.

survival-expert-after-using-shrimp-on-fi.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cook some shrimp. This will only take a few seconds.

steps.text: You manage to cook some shrimp.

Moving onWell done, you've just cooked your first meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.
You accidently burn the shrimp.

Moving onOh no, you've just burnt your meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-cooking-more-shrimp.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to cook some shrimp. This will only take a few seconds.
If the player successfully cooks the shrimp:

steps.text: You manage to cook some shrimp.

Moving onWell done, you've just cooked another meal! Speak to the survival expert if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on. [Click/Tap] on the gate shown and follow the path. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen]/[use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.

survival-expert-speaking-to-the-survival.speaker: Survival Expert
survival-expert-speaking-to-the-survival.text: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?

options.text: Tell me about my skills again.

steps.player: Tell me about my skills again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small tooltip will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: You can also [click/tap] on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Woodcutting again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and [click/tap] on a nearby tree to chop away.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Firemaking again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Fishing again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Tell me about Cooking again.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.

steps.speaker: Survival Expert
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?

steps.player: Nothing thanks.

survival-expert-after-opening-the-gate.text: Moving onFollow the path to find until you get to the door with the yellow arrow above it. [Click/Tap] on the door to open it. Remember that you can also move around by [clicking]/[tapping] on the minimap in the top right.

steps.text: Perhaps you've done enough woodcutting now.

You won't be able to chop oak trees until you have a Woodcutting level of 15. You'll advance to higher Woodcutting levels by chopping down normal trees. At higher Woodcutting levels you will find even more trees you can cut.
You don't have enough inventory space to hold that item.
([Current time in UTC]) You don't have enough inventory space to hold that item.
I can't reach that!
([Current time in UTC]) I can't reach that!

master-chef-opening-the-master-chef-s-do.text: CookingTalk to learn the more advanced aspects of Cooking such as combining ingredients!

master-chef-attempting-to-use-the-range-.text: You haven't got anything suitable for cooking! The master chef can help you out with that.

master-chef-attempting-to-leave-through-.text: You need to finish the Master Chef's tasks first.

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef.speaker: Master Chef
master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef.text: Ah! Welcome, newcomer. I am the Master Chef, Lev. It is here that I will teach you how to cook food truly fit for a king.

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef.player: I already know how to cook. Brynna taught me just now.

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef.speaker: Master Chef
master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef.text: Hahahahahaha! You call THAT cooking? Some shrimp on an open log fire? Oh, no, no, no. I am going to teach you the fine art of cooking bread.
a pot of flour and a bucket of water
The master chef gives you some flour and some water.

Making doughThis is the base for many meals. To make dough you must mix flour with water. To do so, [click/tap] on the flour in your inventory. Then, with the flour highlighted, [click/tap] on the water to combine them into dough.

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef-b.speaker: Master Chef
master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef-b.text: Time for you to learn the fine art of cooking bread.
If the player has neither flour nor water:

steps.text: a pot of flour and a bucket of water
The master chef gives you some flour and some water.

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef-b.text: If the player only has flour:

steps.text: bucket of water

master-chef-talking-to-the-master-chef-b.text: The master chef gives you some water.
If the player only has water:

steps.text: a pot of flour
The master chef gives you some flour.

master-chef-making-the-dough.text: Cooking doughNow you have made the dough, you can bake it into some bread. To do so, just [click/tap] on the indicated range.

master-chef-cooking-the-dough.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to bake some bread. This will take a few seconds.
You manage to bake some bread.

Moving onWell done! You've baked your first loaf of bread. As you gain experience in Cooking, you will be able to make other things like pies and cakes. You can now use the next door to move on. If you need a recap on anything, talk to the master chef.

master-chef-cooking-more-dough.text: Please waitYour character is now attempting to bake some bread. This will take a few seconds.
If the player burns the bread:

steps.text: You accidently burn the bread.

Moving onWell done! You've baked your first loaf of bread. As you gain experience in Cooking, you will be able to make other things like pies and cakes. You can now use the next door to move on. If you need a recap on anything, talk to the master chef.

options.text: Tell me about making dough again.

steps.player: Tell me about making dough again.

steps.speaker: Master Chef
steps.text: It's quite simple. Just use a pot of flour on a bucket of water, or vice versa, and you'll make dough. You can fill a bucket with water at any sink.

steps.speaker: Master Chef
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

options.text: Tell me about range cooking again.

steps.player: Tell me about range cooking again.

steps.speaker: Master Chef
steps.text: The range is the only place you can cook a lot of the more complex foods in Gielinor. To cook on a range, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it. You'll need to make sure you have the required items in your inventory though.

steps.speaker: Master Chef
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

steps.player: Nothing thanks.

master-chef-opening-the-exit-door.text: Fancy a run?When navigating the world, you can either run or walk. Running is faster but you can't run for long as you'll soon run out of energy. You can use the flashing orb next to the minimap to toggle running. Why not try it as you head to the next section?

master-chef-after-toggling-the-run-butto.text: Moving onFollow the path to the next guide. When you get there, [click/tap] on the door to pass through it. Remember, you can [use your arrow keys/swipe across the screen] to rotate the camera.

quest-guide-opening-the-quest-guide-s-do.text: QuestsIt's time to learn about quests! Just talk to the Quest Guide to get started.

quest-guide-opening-to-go-down-the-ladde.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-opening-to-go-down-the-ladde.text: I don't think you're ready to go down there yet.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide.text: Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest list.
Quest journal[Click]/[tap] on the flashing icon to the left of your inventory.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-b.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-b.text: Have you not opened that menu yet?

quest-guide-opening-the-quest-journal.text: Quest journalThis is your quest journal. It lists every quest in the game. Talk to the quest guide again for an explanation on how it works.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: It's very easy to find quest start points. Just look out for the quest icon on your minimap. You should see one marking this house.
The minimap in the top right corner of the screen has various icons to show different points of interest. Look for the icon to the left to find quest start points.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: The quests themselves can vary greatly from collecting beads to hunting down dragons. Completing quests will reward you with all sorts of things, such as new areas and better weapons!

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: There's not a lot more I can tell you about questing. You have to experience the thrill of it yourself to fully understand. Let me know if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on.
Moving onIt's time to enter some caves. [Click/Tap] on the ladder to go down to the next area.

quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.speaker: Quest Guide
quest-guide-talking-to-the-quest-guide-a.text: Would you like to hear about quests again?

steps.player: Yes!

steps.speaker: Quest Guide
steps.text: Within your quest list, you'll unsurprisingly find a list of quests. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.

steps.speaker: Quest Guide
steps.text: If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.

options.text: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.player: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.speaker: Quest Guide
steps.text: Okay then.

mining-instructor-after-entering-the-cav.text: Mining and SmithingNext let's get you a weapon, or more to the point, you can make your first weapon yourself. Don't panic, the mining instructor will help you. Talk to him and he'll tell you all about it.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-leave-th.text: You need to finish with Mining and Smithing first.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-mine-wit.text: You are not ready to mine yet. Please follow the tutorial and you'll be mining in no time.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-use-an-a.text: This is an anvil used for smithing. You'll learn how to use it soon.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-use-the-.text: This is a furnace for smelting metal. You'll learn how to use it soon.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
The mining instructor gives you a bronze pickaxe.
MiningIt's quite simple really. To mine a rock, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it. First up, try mining some tin.

mining-instructor-mining-a-rock.text: Please WaitYour character is now attempting to mine the rock. This should only take a few seconds.
MiningNow that you have some [tin/copper] ore, you just need some [copper/tin] To mine a rock, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it.

mining-instructor-before-obtaining-both-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-before-obtaining-both-.text: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-mine-ore.text: You don't have enough room in your inventory to hold the ore. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold/right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, try mining the rock again.

mining-instructor-after-obtaining-both-o.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-after-obtaining-both-o.text: Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
SmeltingYou now have some tin ore and some copper ore. You can smelt these into a bronze bar. To do so, just [click/tap] on the indicated furnace. Try it now.

mining-instructor-smelting-bronze.text: You smelt the copper and tin together in the furnace.
You retrieve a bar of bronze.
SmithingYou've made a bronze bar! Speak to the mining instructor and he'll show you how to make it into a weapon.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-use-an-a.text: You need a hammer to work the metal with. Talk to the mining instructor to get one.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.player: I have a bronze bar. What now?

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.
If the player does not have enough inventory space:

steps.text: You need some tools for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold/right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the mining instructor again.
Smithing a daggerTo smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. The mining instructor can give you a hammer.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: The mining instructor gives you a hammer.

Smithing a daggerTo smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. To start the process, [click/tap] on the anvil, or alternatively use the bar on it.

mining-instructor-before-making-the-dagg.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-before-making-the-dagg.text: See if you can use the anvil here to make a bronze dagger.
If the player does not have a hammer and has inventory space to receive one:

steps.text: a hammer
The mining instructor gives you a hammer.

Smithing a daggerTo smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. To start the process, [click/tap] on the anvil, or alternatively use the bar on it.

mining-instructor-before-making-the-dagg.text: If the player does not have a hammer and has no inventory space to receive one:

steps.text: You need some tools for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold]/[right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the mining instructor again.
Smithing a daggerTo smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. The mining instructor can give you a hammer.

mining-instructor-opening-the-smithing-m.text: Smithing a daggerNow you have the smithing menu open, you will see a list of all the things you can make. Only the dagger can be made at your skill level; this is shown by the white text under it. You'll need to select the dagger to continue.

mining-instructor-attempting-to-make-oth.text: You cannot make this on Tutorial Island.

mining-instructor-after-smithing-a-bronz.text: Moving onCongratulations, you've made your first weapon. Now it's time to move on. Go through the gates shown by the arrow. Remember, you may need to move the camera to see your surroundings. Speak to the mining instructor for a recap at any time.

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: The player receives a hammer if they have space and are not currently carrying one:

mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.speaker: Mining Instructor
mining-instructor-talking-to-the-mining-.text: Would you like me to recap anything?

steps.player: Tell me about mining again.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe. It's the most inefficient pickaxe available, but it's perfect for a beginner.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: To mine, simply [click/tap] on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?

steps.player: Tell me about smelting again.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.player: Tell me about Smithing again.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Anything else?

options.text: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.player: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.speaker: Mining Instructor
steps.text: Okay then.

mining-instructor-opening-the-gate.text: CombatIn this area you will find out about melee and ranged combat. Speak to the guide and he will tell you all about it.

combat-instructor-attempting-to-climb-th.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-attempting-to-climb-th.text: You're not ready to continue yet. You need to know about combat before you go on.

combat-instructor-attempting-to-enter-th.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-attempting-to-enter-th.text: Oi! Get away from there. Only enter the rat cage when I say so.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
If playing on desktop:

steps.text: Equipping itemsYou now have access to a new interface. [Click/Tap] on the flashing icon of a man, the one to the right of your backpack icon.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If playing on mobile:

steps.text: Equipping itemsYou now have access to a new interface. Tap on the flashing icon of a man, the one underneath your backpack icon.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.

combat-instructor-trying-to-equip-someth.text: You'll be told how to equip items later.

combat-instructor-opening-the-worn-inven.text: Worn inventoryThis is your worn inventory. Here you can see what items you have equipped. In the bottom left corner, you will notice a flashing button with a shield and helmet on it. This button lets you view more details on what you have equipped. [Click/Tap] on it now.

combat-instructor-opening-the-equipment-.text: Equipment statsYou can see what items you are wearing in the worn inventory to the left of the screen, with their combined statistics on the right. Let's add something. [Click/Tap] your dagger to equip it.

combat-instructor-after-equipping-a-bron.text: Equipment statsYou're now holding your dagger. Clothes, armour, weapons and more are equipped like this. Alternatively, you can [click/tap] items directly from your inventory to equip them without opening the stats window. Speak to the combat instructor to continue.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
If the player has no free inventory spaces to receive any required items:

steps.text: You need some new weapons for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold/right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the combat instructor again.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has one free inventory space and does not have a sword or shield:

steps.text: a bronze sword
The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword. He would have given you a wooden shield as well but you didn't have room for it. To get one, drop something and talk to the combat instructor again.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has one free inventory space and has a sword but not a shield:

steps.text: a wooden shield
The combat instructor gives you a wooden shield.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has one free inventory space and has a shield but not a sword:

steps.text: a bronze sword
The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has two free inventory space and does not have a sword or shield:

steps.text: a bronze sword and a wooden shield
The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword and a wooden shield.

Unequipping itemsTo unequip an item, go to your worn inventory and [click/tap] on the item. Alternatively, equipping a new item into the same slot will unequip the old one. Try this out now by swapping your dagger for the sword and shield that the combat instructor gave you.
You don't have enough free space to do that.
([Current time in UTC]) You don't have enough free space to do that.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Let's get you equipped.
If the player is missing a sword or shield:

combat-instructor-after-equipping-a-bron.text: Combat interface[Click/Tap] on the flashing crossed swords icon to open the combat interface.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: You should check out the combat interface.
If the player is missing a sword or shield:

combat-instructor-opening-the-combat-int.text: Combat interfaceThis is your combat interface. From here, you can select the attack style that you'll use in combat. Using different attack styles will give different types of experience. As well as this, monsters are weak to specific attack styles. [Click/Tap] on the gates to continue.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen through the nearby gate and kill one of those rats.

combat-instructor-entering-the-rat-cage.text: AttackingIt's time to slay some rats! To attack a rat, all you have to do is [click/tap] on it. This will cause you to walk over and start hitting it.

combat-instructor-attacking-a-giant-rat.text: Sit back and watchWhile you are fighting you will see a bar over your head. The bar shows how much health you have left. Your opponent will have one too. You will continue to attack the rat until it's dead or you do something else.

combat-instructor-after-killing-a-giant-.text: Well done, you've made your first kill!Pass through the gate and talk to the combat instructor. He will give you your next task.

combat-instructor-attempting-to-attack-a.text: You've already done that. Perhaps you should move on to learn about ranged combat.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.player: I did it! I killed a giant rat!

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: I saw. You seem better at this than I thought. Now that you have grasped basic swordplay, let's move on.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Next up we have ranged combat. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
If the player does not have two free inventory spaces:

steps.text: You need some new weapons for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold]/[right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the combat instructor again.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has exactly one free inventory space:

steps.text: a shortbow
The combat instructor gives you a shortbow. He would have given you some bronze arrows as well but you didn't have room for them. To get some, drop something and talk to the combat instructor again.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows
The combat instructor gives you a shortbow and some bronze arrows.

Rat rangingBefore you can use the shortbow and arrows you'll need to equip them by clicking on them. Once equipped with the ranging gear, try killing another rat. You don't need to enter the pen this time. To attack a rat, just [click/tap] on it.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Use your bow and arrows to kill one of those rats from outside the pen.
If the player does not have a shortbow and has less than 50 arrows:

steps.text: a shortbow and up to 50 bronze arrows
The combat instructor gives you a shortbow and some bronze arrows.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player has a shortbow but less than 50 arrows:

steps.text: up to 50 bronze arrows
The combat instructor gives you some bronze arrows.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: If the player does not have a shortbow but has 50 arrows:

steps.text: a shortbow
The combat instructor gives you a shortbow.

combat-instructor-attempting-to-enter-th.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-attempting-to-enter-th.text: No, don't enter the pit. Range the rats from outside the cage.

combat-instructor-after-killing-a-second.text: Moving onYou have completed the tasks here. To move on, [click/tap] on the indicated ladder. If you need to go over any of what you learnt here, just talk to the combat instructor and he'll tell you what he can.

combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.speaker: Combat Instructor
combat-instructor-talking-to-the-combat-.text: Do you need something?

steps.player: Tell me about combat stats again.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
If playing on desktop:

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
If playing on mobile:

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to see what combat level they are.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?

options.text: Tell me about melee combat again.

steps.player: Tell me about melee combat again.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Now, did you want to hear anything else?

options.text: Tell me about ranged combat again.

steps.player: Tell me about ranged combat again.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Anything else you wanted to know?

steps.player: Tell me about the Wilderness again.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Ah yes, the Wilderness. It is a place of evil, mark my words. Many is the colleague I have lost in that foul place.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Your current Wilderness level is shown at the bottom right of the screen. The final thing you should know about the Wilderness is being 'skulled'.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: If you attack another player without them having attacked first, you will gain a skull above your character's head.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: What this means is that if you die while skulled, you will lose EVERYTHING that your character was carrying.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: When skulled, you should try to avoid dying for the twenty minutes or so it will take for the skull to wear off.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: If you don't wish to end up there, take notice of the warning you will receive when getting near to it.

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Now, was there anything more?

options.text: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.player: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.speaker: Combat Instructor
steps.text: Okay then.

combat-instructor-attempting-to-attack-a.text: You've already done that. Perhaps you should move on.

combat-instructor-climbing-the-exit-ladd.text: BankingThis is the Bank of Gielinor, where you can store all your most valued items. To open your bank, just [click/tap] on the indicated booth.

banking-tutorial.text: If attempting to use the poll booth before talking to the banker:

steps.text: You can come back to this when you've learnt about the bank.

banking-tutorial-attempting-to-access-th.text: You need to open your bank first.

banking-tutorial-opening-the-bank.text: BankingThis is your bank. You can store things here for safekeeping. To deposit something from your inventory, just [click/tap] on it. You can withdraw things in the same way. To continue, close the bank and [click/tap] on the indicated poll booth.

banking-tutorial-attempting-to-access-th.text: You need to visit the poll booth before you can proceed through this door.

banking-tutorial-accessing-the-poll-boot.text: Poll booths are found in towns across the world. The Old School RuneScape community is invited to vote on future game updates, to decide whether each update should or shouldn't be released.
Voting is open to members with a skill total of 300. To preserve the old-school character of this game, an update must gain 70% support to be released.
A flag appears on the booth to let you know when you're invited to vote in a poll.
If the player is on a world that does not allow polls:

steps.text: Polls are not available on this world.

banking-tutorial-accessing-the-poll-boot.text: Moving onPolls are run periodically to let the Old School RuneScape community vote on how the game should - or shouldn't - change. When you're ready, move on through the door indicated.

banking-tutorial-entering-the-account-gu.text: Account ManagementThe guide here will tell you all about your account. Just [click/tap] on him to hear what he's got to say.

banking-tutorial-attempting-to-leave-thr.text: You need to talk to the Account Guide before you are allowed to proceed through this door.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: There's various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let's take a look at it now.
Account Management[Click/tap] on the flashing icon to open your Account Management menu.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Before we go any further, you should have a look at the Account Management menu.

banking-tutorial-opening-the-account-man.text: Account ManagementThis is your Account Management menu where you can control various aspects of your account. Talk to the Account Guide to learn more.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
If the player is on a free world:

steps.speaker: Account Guide
steps.text: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: If the player is on a members world:

steps.speaker: Account Guide
steps.text: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.player: But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.player: So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Exactly!

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.player: Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
Moving onContinue through the next door.

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.speaker: Account Guide
banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.text: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?

banking-tutorial-talking-to-the-account-.prompt: Would you like to hear about your account again?

steps.player: Yes!

steps.speaker: Account Guide
steps.text: Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.

steps.speaker: Account Guide
steps.text: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!

prayer-tutorial-attempting-to-leave-thro.text: You need to finish Brother Brace's tasks before you are allowed to proceed through this door.

steps.text: You already have full Prayer points.
([Current time in UTC]) You already have full Prayer points.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.
Prayer menu[Click/Tap] on the flashing icon to open the Prayer menu.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: You should open the indicated menu to continue.

prayer-tutorial-opening-the-prayer-menu.text: Prayer menuTalk with Brother Brace and he'll tell you about prayers.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click]/[Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click]/[tap] it again to deactivate it.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by [clicking]/[tapping] them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: That's all I have to teach you for now. If you need a reminder about your prayers, just speak to me again.
Your final instructor!You're almost finished on tutorial island. Pass through the door to find the path leading to your final instructor.

prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.speaker: Brother Brace
prayer-tutorial-talking-to-brother-brace.text: Peace be with you, my child. Can I help you?

steps.speaker: Brother Brace
steps.text: Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click/Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click/tap] it again to deactivate it.

steps.speaker: Brother Brace
steps.text: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.

steps.speaker: Brother Brace
steps.text: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by [clicking/tapping] them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.

steps.speaker: Brother Brace
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

options.text: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.player: Nope, I'm ready to move on!

steps.speaker: Brother Brace
steps.text: Okay then.

prayer-tutorial-after-exiting-the-chapel.text: Your final instructor!Follow the path to the wizard's house, where you will be shown how to cast spells. When you get there, just talk with the magic instructor.

prayer-tutorial-attempting-to-access-the.text: Only Group Ironmen can cross over to The Node. If you wish to become a Group Ironman, speak to the Ironman tutor north-east of here.

ironman-tutor-speaking-to-the-ironman-tu.text: If the player is on a regular account:

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: Hello, [player name]. I'm Paul, the Ironman tutor. What can I do for you?

ironman-tutor-speaking-to-the-ironman-tu.text: If the player is an Ironman:

steps.player: Hey there Paul.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: Hail, [Ironman type]! What can I do for you?

steps.player: Tell me about Ironmen.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: When you play as an Ironman, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: As an Ironman, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Ironman.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: In addition to the standard restrictions, Hardcore Ironmen only have one life. In the event of a dangerous death, your Hardcore Ironmen status will be downgraded to that of a standard Ironman, and your

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Iron man hiscores.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, as Group Ironmen. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Ironmen except you can trade your items with each other!

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: If you are a daring bunch, you could even try Hardcore Group Ironmen. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regular Group Ironmen.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would become Unranked Group Ironmen, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become an Ultimate Ironman, a game mode inspired by the player IronNoBank.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: In addition to the standard restrictions, Ultimate Ironmen are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being a standard Ironman, an Ultimate Ironman, a Hardcore Ironman, a Group Ironman, a Hardcore Group Ironman or a regular character.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: Once you've left this island, you'll be able to find my colleague Adam in Lumbridge, but he'll only let you switch your restrictions downwards, not upwards.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: So he will let Hardcore Ironmen or Ultimate Ironmen downgrade to standard Ironmen, and he'll let all types of Ironman become normal players.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: I must warn you that Ironman mode is not recommended for new players. You can still give it a go if you think you're up for the challenge though.

options.text: I'd like to change my Ironman mode.

steps.player: I'd like to change my Ironman mode.

steps.speaker: Ironman tutor
steps.text: Make sure you've got your Ironman settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.

steps.player: I'm fine, thanks.

magic-instructor-talking-to-the-magic-in.speaker: Magic Instructor
magic-instructor-talking-to-the-magic-in.text: Currently you can only cast one offensive spell called Wind Strike. Let's try it out on one of those chickens.
Terrova gives you some air runes and mind runes.

Magic castingYou now have some runes. All spells require runes to cast them. Look for the Wind Strike spell in your magic interface. [Click/Tap] on this spell to select it and then [click/tap] on a chicken to cast it. Talk to the instructor if you need more runes.
